questions.q: A is twice as old as B. If A is 40 years old, how old is B?
questions.explain: If A is twice B's age and A is 40, then B = 40/2 = 20 years.

What is the area of a circle with radius 7 cm? (Take pi = 22/7)
questions.explain: Area = pi x r^2 = (22/7) x 7 x 7 = 154 cm2.

questions.q: If 3 workers build a wall in 6 days, how many days for 6 workers?
questions.explain: More workers = fewer days. 3 workers x 6 days = 18 worker-days. 18/6 = 3 days.
